summary: E-commerce storefront for 'Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point' - a grocery store with product browsing, cart, ordering, admin panel for product management, Google sign-in with phone verification, mobile recharge facility, delivery fee based on distance, and INR pricing
architectural_notes: Use INR (₹) for all product pricing
Product catalog limited to groceries (aata, rice, sugar, spices, shampoo) - no eggs or bakery
Fetch store details from Google Maps link: https://maps.app.goo.gl/i9v1ukJNWdsgT5gU7
Store name: 'Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point'
Authentication requires both Google OAuth and phone number
Mobile recharge requires: amount, mobile number, operator selection
Delivery logic: free within 1km, distance-based fee calculated for orders beyond 1km
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- App icon with store logo for mobile devices featuring the shopkeeper illustration and store name, suitable for home screen display (app-icon-192.dim_192x192.png)
- Large app icon with store logo for mobile devices featuring the shopkeeper illustration and store name, optimized for high-resolution displays (app-icon-512.dim_512x512.png)
- Apple touch icon with store logo for iOS devices featuring the shopkeeper illustration and store name (apple-touch-icon.dim_180x180.png)

existing_features.title: Create a product grid displaying grocery items (aata, rice, sugar, spices, shampoo, etc.) with product images, names, and prices in INR (₹). Exclude egg and bakery products.
Implement category filtering system for grocery products allowing users to browse by product categories (grains, spices, personal care, etc.)
Create a shopping cart system that allows users to add products, adjust quantities, view cart total in ₹, and proceed to checkout
Implement Google sign-in authentication with mandatory phone number collection during registration or first login
Create order placement system that collects customer details (delivery address, phone number) and submits orders for products in the cart

Display store details prominently including name 'Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point', address from Google Maps link (https://maps.app.goo.gl/i9v1ukJNWdsgT5gU7), and contact phone number 9142876085
Add a 'Call Us' support button/link prominently displayed that dials phone number 9142876085 when clicked
Create a mobile recharge ordering system with a banner/section where customers can order recharge packs by entering mobile number, selecting operator (telecom company), and specifying recharge amount
Implement distance-based delivery fee calculation: free delivery up to 1km, paid delivery fee for distances beyond 1km (e.g., 2km requires payment)
Display QR code for online payment of delivery fees and order amounts with clear instructions for customers
Create an admin panel accessible only to the store owner for adding new products (name, category, price in ₹, image) and removing existing products from the inventory

Design a professional, visually cohesive storefront with a warm, trustworthy aesthetic suitable for a local grocery store. Use earthy tones, clear typography, and an organized layout that emphasizes product browsing and easy navigation.

Replace the existing hero banner on the homepage with the uploaded shop banner image (IMG_20251019_102908.png) showing the store interior, logo, Aadhar enabled payment system, stationery availability, and contact number

Replace the store logo in the header navigation with the uploaded circular logo image (Gemini_Generated_Image_rjk9furjk9furjk9.png) featuring the shopkeeper illustration and 'Maa Bhawani General Store' text in Hindi

Configure the application for mobile app deployment by adding Progressive Web App (PWA) capabilities including a web manifest file with appropriate app icons, theme colors matching the store's earthy palette, display mode set to 'standalone', and orientation set to 'portrait'. Include all required icon sizes for iOS and Android.

Add a service worker to enable offline functionality and app installation prompts. The service worker should cache critical assets (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, product images) and implement a cache-first strategy for static resources and network-first strategy for API calls.

Optimize the mobile experience by enhancing touch interactions, improving button sizes for finger-friendly tap targets (minimum 44x44px), adding touch gestures for cart drawer, and ensuring all interactive elements are easily accessible on mobile screens.

Update the HTML meta tags to include mobile-specific viewport configuration, Apple mobile web app capabilities, and Android app configuration for proper mobile app behavior when installed on home screens.
